changes.title: Leaf jitter
items: Every tree has its own slightly different leaf colour, so forests look less uniform (a small hue and brightness jitter; pause-page sliders)

changes.title: Music lab pause
items: The pause page has a Music Lab: its 🎛 button opens the lab's sliders down the right edge, driving the night's own music as it plays. Jump to any wave, section or record; try the singer's voices, breath and effects; set every part's level, mute or solo; copy the settings out, paste them back or reset. Esc resumes with the panel up, so you hear the changes in play; ✕ closes it. In the bedroom, ▶ Preview plays a passage.

changes.title: Route seer hat
items: A new hat power, the Route-seer: worn, you see the whole ley line out to the last runestone, and every stone's beacon
The Edge-seer and Route-seer hats work only while worn: only the witch wearing one sees what it shows
